verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a Bitbucket REST or public API. The only programmatic surface shown is an official Atlassian MCP server, which lets agents drive Atlassian products but is not shown to cover Bitbucket specifically. Probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs on support.atlassian.com all returned 404, so no machine-readable API documentation was found. Missing for 10: a documented Bitbucket public REST API reference, an OpenAPI spec, evidence of the API's auth and endpoint coverage, confirmation that the MCP server covers Bitbucket, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
